faqs.title: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS – SMP FOR ALOPECIA (SCALP MICROPIGMENTATION)

list.q: Can SMP for alopecia worsen alopecia areata, totalis, or universalis?
list.a: No – SMP treatment (scalp micropigmentation) is performed shallowly in the skin, without affecting hair follicles in alopecia. Hair tattoo is safe.

list.q: Is the difference noticeable in SMP for alopecia when hair falls around the treated area?
list.a: No – scalp micropigmentation for alopecia is designed to look natural even if hair loss from alopecia areata continues.

list.q: How long does the effect of SMP for alopecia (scalp micropigmentation) last?
list.a: 2–4 years. Refreshing the hair tattoo for alopecia is possible with one SMP session.

list.q: Is SMP treatment suitable for women with diffuse alopecia or alopecia areata?
list.a: Yes – scalp micropigmentation (hair tattoo) for alopecia is adjusted to ensure a natural SMP effect on existing hair in women with alopecia.
